about_the_game:
Tired of RTS games that demand your entire evening and/or your entire wallet?

Orion Wars delivers the strategic depth you crave in quick 10-25 minute sessions. Perfect for a lunch break, challenger queue times, between meetings, or when you want "just one more game" without losing sleep.  At just $4.99, Orion Wars delivers RTS depth without the time commitment or the $40 price tag.

Real strategy without the complexity
Most RTS games overwhelm you with hundreds of units and endless tech trees. Orion Wars gives you just two unit types but plenty of strategic possibilities. Easy to learn, impossible to master.

Battles that respect your time
Command massive fleets of hundreds or thousands of units in real-time combat that actually ends. No more 3-hour slogs. Jump in, execute your strategy, and claim victory (or learn from defeat) in minutes.

Two paths to victory 
Total Domination: Crush every enemy system with overwhelming force
Singularity Ascension: Out research your opponents and transcend to a higher plane
Your strategy, your playstyle.  Both paths reward tactical thinking.

KEY FEATURES
✓ 10-25 minute matches - RTS for humans with lives
✓ Simple controls, deep strategy - two unit types, infinite tactics
✓ Massive real-time battles - hundreds to thousands of units on screen
✓ Procedurally generated galaxies - every match is unique
✓ Multiple difficulty levels - from casual to brutal
✓ Research tree - unlock powerful weapons, defenses, and the Singularity
✓ Conquer AI opponents - multiple enemy behaviors and strategies
✓ Multiplayer mode  - battle your friends for galactic supremacy

Perfect for RTS veterans who don't have time for epic sessions, strategy newcomers intimidated by complex games, and anyone who wants tactical gameplay without homework.

Jump into the action. Command your fleets. Conquer the galaxy before dinner gets cold.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6100
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060/ Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Fast-paced space RTS with 10-25 minute matches. Command fleets, conquer systems, or research the Singularity. Simple controls, strategic depth, but no 3-hour commitments required.
